subject: general
question: Which of the following processes is carried out on connecting rods to locate the two halves relative to one another?

options.text: Mirror finishing is done by diamond turning machine
Dimples are created on the surface

solution:
The correct answer is __Serrations are used.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Serrations__ are specially designed teeth-like structures used for connecting rods.
 
• They ensure precise alignment between the two halves of the connecting rod.
 
• Serrations prevent misalignment and ensure stability under high stress and loads.
 
• This design is commonly used in automotive and mechanical applications.
 
• Other methods like taper threads or dimples do not offer the same level of precise relative positioning.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Mirror Finishing:**

 
 
• This process is used to create highly reflective surfaces, often for aesthetic or functional purposes.
 
• It does not contribute to the alignment of components.
 
 
 
• **Taper Threads:**
 
 
• Used in applications requiring secure fastening through threaded connections.
 
• Not suitable for aligning connecting rod halves.
 
 
 
• **Dimples:**
 
 
• Dimples are small depressions on surfaces, often used for aerodynamic or aesthetic purposes.
 
• They do not provide alignment functionality for connecting rods.
